description: Clues are 16px+, all 30 letter controls are 44px+ and no horizontal overflow at 320–1440
Same-letter attempts, same-cell deselection and Escape spend no swaps
Correct words lock; Home/End navigate and keyboard Undo restores letters without refunding swaps or perfect eligibility
Hint cancel is inert; confirmed advice costs one nudge and survives reload without another charge, then clears after a real trade
A five-swap assisted win is solved, never perfect

Five real optimal swaps finish perfectly, lock all words, keep a terminal result and record its actual score
Real portrait/square PNG downloads contain frozen aggregate scores and no answer words
Reopened sharing keeps played date after midnight; mocked cancellation preserves focus and denied clipboard selects manual copy
Revealed Practice remains explicit and cannot replace a Daily win

No browser page errors
